about_the_game:
💖 Five Girls. One Sweet Start.
This Prologue Edition lets you experience the first two chapter of each girl’s story — enough to spark your curiosity, heat up the screen, and leave you wanting more.

In this sexy, story-driven visual novel, you’ll meet:
🧛 Komori – A rebellious punk vampire with a taste for trouble… and maybe your blood.
🧟 Kemuriko – A bubbly zombie girl hungry for new experiences.
👼 Sora – A gentle angel dreaming of love and protection.
💪 Ryoko – A tomboy gym girl who pushes herself — and maybe you — to the limit.
🌸 Jochu – A devoted maid who takes pride in pleasing others.

Each first chapter is packed with flirtation, teasing, and reveals a glimpse into their unique kinks. At the end of each, you’ll unlock a sexy 3D scene with a fully adjustable camera, letting you admire every detail from any angle.

The Prologue is just the beginning — if one girl catches your heart (or your lust), the full game continues their story to the steamy finale.
